text: The four extension tables party_ext, contact_point_ext, account_ext and valuation_ext are created by RWB-P1-E1069-DB in rwb_source_data. This story seeds and keeps their 49 dictionary fields DF-EXT-001 to DF-EXT-049 and creates none of the tables, so the conformance test compares the 13 tables present in rwb_source_data and the 49 extension-table dictionary rows are matched with a column once that story has run; the estate-wide legacy count of 1,062 matched fields is reached only then, together with the 75 tables matched in their owners' schemas.
why: P1 owns the four tables but the DB slice of RWB-E1-069 delivers them, so the legacy 1,062-field assertion cannot be satisfied inside one service's schema in one pipeline run while 49 of its fields belong to tables another story creates.
